frame.note: The region reported, not a located site.

attribution.name: NASA Worldview Snapshots
attribution.note: Public domain, courtesy of NASA EOSDIS GIBS.

before.shows: What the eye would see from orbit. Cloud is white, forest dark green, silt-laden floodwater pale brown.

after.shows: The same scene from a different satellite on a different overpass — a second chance at a gap in the cloud.

latest.shows: Radar brightness, terrain-corrected. Smooth surfaces — open water, wet sand, fresh mud — reflect away from the sensor and read DARK. Rough ground reads bright.
latest.overpass: satellite pass, either ascending or descending

comparable_note: The two frames come from different instruments — true colour before, true colour, second satellite after — because nothing else could see the ground on both dates. They are shown side by side rather than as a slider: sliding between two instruments shows the instrument changing.
